description: Implementation of VideoRenderer class for video decoding and rendering, including buffering, seeking, and state management.

classes.name: VideoRendererImpl
classes.description: Implements video rendering, buffering, seeking, and state management for video playback.

methods.name: VideoRendererImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the video renderer with decoder, media time provider, algorithm, and sink.

methods.name: ~VideoRendererImpl
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources and resetting decoder.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the decoder and sink with callbacks for error, preroll, and end of playback.

methods.name: WriteSamples
methods.description: Feeds input buffers (video samples) into the decoder.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream to the decoder.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Performs a seek operation to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: CanAcceptMoreData
methods.description: Checks if the renderer can accept more input data.

methods.name: SetBounds
methods.description: Sets rendering bounds for the sink.

methods.name: GetCurrentDecodeTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target for rendering.

methods.name: OnDecoderStatus
methods.description: Handles status updates and frames from the decoder.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Performs rendering of video frames using the algorithm.

methods.name: OnSeekTimeout
methods.description: Handles retry logic for seek timeout.

methods.name: CheckBufferingState
methods.description: Checks and logs buffering and state conditions.

methods.name: CheckForFrameLag
methods.description: Logs warnings if frame lag behind media time is detected.
